career_ladder.note: Panchayat Executive Officers (PEO) and Junior Assistants (JA) are recruited under the Panchayati Raj & Drinking Water Department, Government of Odisha. Promotion opportunities lead from grassroots Gram Panchayat management to block-level and district-level administrative posts under the Odisha Gram Panchayat Service Rules and Odisha Subordinate Administrative Service.

exam_scheme.note: The Combined Recruitment Examination for Panchayat Executive Officer (PEO) and Junior Assistant (JA) consists of a Written Examination (OMR / Offline Mode), followed by a Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills (qualifying), and Document Verification with District Cadre counseling.

stages.source_label: OSSSC PEO & Junior Assistant Examination Scheme (Advt No. IIE-07/2023-492(C)/OSSSC)

papers.paper_name: Combined Written Test (English 35 Q, Odia 35 Q, Mathematics 35 Q, General Knowledge 35 Q, Computer Knowledge 35 Q, Logical Reasoning 5 Q)
papers.negative_marking: 0.50 marks deducted per incorrect answer (1/2 mark penalty)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying marks: 35% for SC/ST/PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Sports, 40% for General and SEBC candidates

financial_package.note: Panchayat Executive Officers (PEO) and Junior Assistants in Odisha are appointed under Pay Matrix Level 4 of the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017 (Pay Scale ₹19,900 - ₹63,200 with entry basic pay of ₹19,900). Pay and allowances are disbursed through the Panchayati Raj & Drinking Water Department, Government of Odisha.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017, Finance Department, Government of Odisha
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated based on entry basic pay of ₹19,900 + 58% Dearness Allowance (₹11,542) + House Rent Allowance (9% for rural block/panchayat headquarters, up to 18% in municipal areas: ₹1,791 to ₹3,582) + Medical Allowance (₹500) and fixed rural field allowance. Deductions comprise 10% NPS (Basic + DA = ₹3,144), Professional Tax (₹200), and Group Insurance Scheme (GIS ~₹250).
official_perks: Government staff quarters or House Rent Allowance (HRA at 9% to 18% as applicable to posting location)
Conveyance / travel allowance for official visits to Gram Panchayat wards and block headquarters
Comprehensive medical treatment reimbursement under Odisha Government Servants' Medical Attendance Rules
Dearness Allowance (DA) linked to state government cost-of-living adjustments
Contributory pension scheme under New Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% government contribution
Leave benefits including Earned Leave, Casual Leave, Half Pay Leave, and Maternity Leave per Odisha Service Rules
